caption: The drawing depicts a rectangular design resembling a patterned rug, with a central area containing the word "GOOD" in bold red capital letters outlined in dark blue or green. This central area has a red-pink background with a geometric pattern of curved and straight dark blue or green lines. Surrounding the central section is a larger rectangular field filled with a mottled olive-brown color. There are several decorative borders: an inner border of dark green, followed by a blue border with evenly spaced, semi-circular blue shapes, then a thicker red border with a diamond pattern in blue, red, white, and gray, and finally a thin gold or yellow outline. Each corner of the rectangular design contains a small square in pink. The overall composition is symmetrical, and the drawing is outlined on a light beige or off-white background. The artist's signature, "Elbert S. Mowery," appears in the lower right corner outside the borders.
title: Shaker Rug
